title: Free and easy
body: Best free app for tracking habits, but I would suggest to have the possibility to add habit one day per month for example. But anyway, best app ever !!!
author: ggfeqhsureglvfvbreb

title: FREE AND HAS EVERYTHING
body: Thank you so much for this app! I’ve looked everywhere for a habit tracker that’s completely free and one that can be interacted with through widgets!
author: Mehdi CHK
